findings.description: Directory page ese-dir (https://ese.washu.edu/faculty-research/directory.html) retrieved and parsed: 75 faculty cards (28 tenure-track, 24 affiliate, 13 adjunct, 10 senior). Names match brief.people exactly (75/75); no omission in either direction.
Adjunct cards (13) carry no title and no profile link on the directory; they are decided on the directory tag 'adjunct' only.

Profile pages were fetched for all affiliate, senior, lecturer and teaching/practice-titled rows. Aris Sotiras's directory-linked profile returned 'The page does not exist' on two fetches, and three alternate official URLs also failed (see his record). No source_failure is raised because the required list page downloaded. No unresolved decisions.
